claims.statement: The Ministry of Finance states that receiving invoices through KSeF has been mandatory since 1 February 2026 and that issuance obligations were phased from February and April 2026, with the smallest firms deferred through 2026.
Official KSeF guidance identifies structured FA(3), verification QR codes, offline and outage modes, attachments, and KSeF identifiers as distinct operational elements.

contrary_evidence: The Ministry and accounting-software vendors provide KSeF tools, making generic e-invoicing highly commoditized.
Construction buyers may still reject an officially accepted invoice for contract reasons outside KSeF.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: validate inside one installer, then onboard cohorts through construction accounting offices.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 1000 firms averaging 500 PLN monthly including usage would produce 6 million PLN ARR; profitable founder ownership could exceed 5 million PLN net worth in years 5 to 8.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 15 to 20 hours weekly for one accounting connector and one construction invoice archetype.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 85% gross margin before connector support and partner revenue share.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: under six months if one accounting partner produces twenty retained 399 PLN accounts.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 399 PLN monthly plus 1 PLN per released invoice.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: mandatory receipt and repeated milestone billing make the workflow monthly and sticky.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A buyer-specific correction graph linking KSeF schema, contract terms, attachments, and payment acceptance
fingerprint.customer: Polish construction subcontractors and renewable installers issuing milestone invoices
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Construction accounting offices, wholesalers, ERP implementers, and general-contractor supplier programs
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Vertical invoice-release middleware with accounting and project-system connectors
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The issuer pays monthly and per invoice that receives a KSeF identifier linked to a complete commercial pack
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A milestone is complete and an invoice must pass KSeF plus the buyer's contractual acceptance checks

founder_fit: The family installation business provides a realistic construction invoice pilot.
Schema mapping and contract-document reconciliation fit AI and data skills.
Accounting-office and wholesaler channels reduce founder-led sales intensity.
risks: KSeF interface and transition rules may change.
Handling authorization tokens and invoices creates security obligations.
ERP vendors can copy vertical fields if the wedge proves valuable.

structure.control_point: KSeF identifier and contract-completeness record before the buyer payment clock begins
structure.critical_dependency: Stable KSeF access and proof that contract-level preflight shortens collection

thesis: A construction-specific KSeF bridge could validate FA structure, contract milestone, retention, split lines, attachment references, buyer job code, and offline-mode evidence before releasing an invoice. It would bind the returned KSeF number to the commercial evidence that the payer needs, turning government acceptance into a clean accounts-receivable handoff rather than merely generating XML.
title: KSeF Contract-to-Invoice Release for Construction SMEs
uncertainties: The volume of KSeF-accepted but commercially disputed construction invoices is unknown.
The smallest attractive segment may already be locked into accounting suites.
The 55000 PLN capital figure and all commercial figures below are hypotheses.
